key_insight: IANN unifies seven equivariant interatomic neural network architectures in one PyTorch framework, making architecture selection a one-word configuration change.
engineering_relevance: Shared training and deployment interfaces reduce re-engineering when comparing potentials or moving models into ASE and LAMMPS simulations.
method: Standardize atomic data, training and deployment across PaiNN, NequIP, MACE, Allegro, EquiformerV2, EquiformerV3 and UMA.
Derive forces, stresses and virials analytically from energy via atomic-graph edge vectors, including periodic boundaries.
Automatically configure distributed training and support self-describing checkpoints, uncertainty ensembles and TorchScript deployment.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports architecture comparisons on a shared dataset of millions of structures and releases PaiNN foundation models trained on 41.9 million curated DFT structures spanning PBE, RPBE and r2SCAN.
watch_item: The abstract provides no quantitative accuracy or speed benchmarks, so task-specific validation remains necessary before production use.
paper_title: IANN: A Unified Framework for Equivariant InterAtomic Neural Networks with User-Friendly Implementation
